value.author: codex
value.text: Functional review found a real defect: src/server.ts never mounted createApp() — legal routes/308 aliases existed only in the tested app factory while the running server kept its own duplicated route stack (catch-all SPA served 200 for every path, /impressum did not redirect). Fixed by rewriting server.ts to consume createApp() and keep only DB init + listen + SSE cleanup. Verified live against throwaway Postgres: /legal-notice serves standalone page, /impressum 308->/legal-notice, healthz + SPA fallback + cookie-consent.js intact. 46/46 tests, changelog:check green, npm audit 0 vulns.

patch.value: Work completed and released in 2026.7.10. Release attribution set explicitly so pm-changelog --respect-item-release files the entry under 2026.7.10 instead of the current release notes.
A closed item whose changelog entry appears under the 2026.7.10 heading it actually shipped in, leaving the current release notes untouched.
Item remained in_progress with no activity after its work shipped, so the delivery was absent from the changelog while still counting as open work in every fleet audit.

Retired as shipped: the ecosystem release readiness pass of 2026-07-06 was completed and released in 2026.7.10, but the item was never closed and sat in progress ever since, inflating every fleet audit.
